# PC98 wordmark provenance

Runtime PNG: `PC98.png`.

Vendored from private `umrk-assets`, commit `6a4f65d902a4f18c3e1d2394135dc7f61d329a0c`,
`Systems/WORDMARKS/exports/PC98.png`.
PNG SHA-256: `1adc47e526917e0723f652107c4f86e5a5104648da4deab99f1aec1588a76230`.
Editable SVG SHA-256: `326a4a9eeece3a98a96837d085a8737bd6214ac9fc9c70d3e1aa8cd47b8d22f8`.

This white RGBA export has a maximum edge of 1024 pixels. Jawaka tints it to
the current text color. Your build uses this checked-in copy and does not fetch
the private repository. The source revision records provenance only.

## Source and license

Source: Darklanlan's vector reconstruction of NEC's 1982 PC-9800 series logo,
[Wikimedia Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PC9800_logo_1982.svg),
revision of 29 June 2016, 09:29 UTC. The page identifies it as PD-textlogo
(simple shapes/text below the copyright threshold). `sources/PC98-upstream.svg`
is the unmodified download. The derivative retains the original P, C, hyphen,
9, and 8 paths, removes the final 00 and Japanese series suffix, recolors the
lettering white, and adds padding. It reads PC-98 for the catalog's PC98 ID.
The NEC name and marks remain NEC's trademarks.

No image model was used. No generation prompt applies.
